task_description: Implement the project creation flow: Design Library template gallery for consultants, multi-step creation wizard (browse templates, enter details, create project), snapshot builder utility, and integration with existing projectStore for post-creation navigation. Includes Zustand store, components, and comprehensive tests.

verification.summary: tsc --noEmit passes cleanly. All 228 tests pass (175 existing + 53 new). Review fixes applied: hash uses recursive sort-keys, idempotency key is stable across retries, queries run in parallel, post-creation failures are distinguished from creation failures, customer/site references stored in snapshot_data.project_metadata.
